from pathlib import Path
from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import asdict
import json, time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from IPython.display import display, Markdown
from src import classroom_labs as lab

RUN_OPENDSS = False       # True: fresh full-model audit + separate AC MPC solve in L5
RUN_LOCAL_LLAMA = False   # True: one optional local call in L11
ROOT = Path.cwd()
assert (ROOT / 'data/lindistflow3_network.json').exists(), 'Start Jupyter in the tutorial folder'
plt.rcParams.update({'figure.dpi': 120, 'font.size': 10, 'axes.spines.top': False,
                     'axes.spines.right': False})
pd.set_option('display.max_colwidth', None)
timings = {}
print('Default: fresh linear numerical labs; recorded LLM examples; no training or network.')

request = lab.validate_request(dict(task='voltage', backend='lindistflow3',
    load_scale=1.0, rating_fraction=0.80, revision=1))
candidate = {'control': [0.25, 0.0]}
evidence = lab.bind_evidence(request, candidate, {'example_only': True, 'passed': True})
changed_request = {**request, 'load_scale': 1.10, 'revision': 2}
guard = pd.DataFrame([
    {'test': 'same request + same command', 'binding_pass': lab.bound_to(request, candidate, evidence)},
    {'test': 'changed load; old evidence', 'binding_pass': lab.bound_to(changed_request, candidate, evidence)},
    {'test': 'changed command; old evidence', 'binding_pass': lab.bound_to(request, {'control': [0.50, 0.]}, evidence)}])
display(guard)
assert guard.binding_pass.tolist() == [True, False, False]

LOAD_SCALE = 1.0
RATING_FRACTION = 0.80
started = time.perf_counter()
voltage = lab.voltage_lab(LOAD_SCALE, RATING_FRACTION)
timings['L2 fresh MPC + SAC + checks'] = time.perf_counter() - started
print(voltage['mode'])
display(voltage['table'])
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 3.2))
for row in voltage['evaluations']:
    v = np.asarray(row['evidence'].get('voltages_pu', []))
    axes[0].plot(np.sort(v), label=row['method'])
voltage['table'].plot.bar(x='method', y='max_allowed_current_pct', ax=axes[1], legend=False, color='#16817a')
axes[0].axhspan(.95, 1.05, color='#16817a', alpha=.08)
axes[0].set(xlabel='Voltage rank (each curve sorted separately)', ylabel='Voltage (p.u.)', title='Fresh voltage distributions')
axes[0].legend(); axes[1].axhline(100, color='#b7502e', linestyle='--')
axes[1].set(ylabel='Allowed-current utilization (%)', title='Feasibility precedes ranking', xlabel='')
axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

pool = lab.saved_pool('test_01')
display(pd.DataFrame(pool['responses'])[['model_id', 'operation_id', 'reason', 'seconds', 'source']])
display(pd.DataFrame([{'operation': ', '.join(c['operation_ids']),
    'votes': c['vote_count'], 'share': c['vote_share'], 'parameters': c['operation']['parameters']}
    for c in pool['pool']['candidates']]))
print('ARCHIVED ACTUAL LLM; original context:', pool['context']['id'])
print('Distinct physical candidates:', len(pool['pool']['candidates']))
print('Malformed/duplicate votes rejected:', len(pool['pool']['rejected']))

decision = pool['selection']
print('Frozen:', pool['frozen'], '| selected-feedback training updates:', pool['training_updates'])
print('Bandit operation:', decision.operation_id, '| predicted reward:', round(decision.predicted_reward, 4))
print('Same canonical choice as majority:', decision.candidate_id == pool['vote_id'])
started = time.perf_counter()
selected_trials = lab.trial_saved_selection(pool)
timings['L4 new verification of archived choices'] = time.perf_counter() - started
display(selected_trials['table'])
assert pool['frozen'] and pool['training_updates'] == 24

started = time.perf_counter()
scope_audit = lab.backend_audit(pool, run_opendss=RUN_OPENDSS)
timings['L5 selected model scope checks'] = time.perf_counter() - started
display(scope_audit['table'])
print(scope_audit['optional_mode'])
print('An MV-only PASS cannot acknowledge a request requiring full MV/LV coverage.')

CAPACITIES_KW = (40., 60., 80., 100., 120.)
started = time.perf_counter()
restoration = lab.restoration_sweep(CAPACITIES_KW)
timings['L6 fresh MILP sweep + independent enumeration'] = time.perf_counter() - started
display(restoration['table'].drop(columns='pickup'))
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 3.2))
for i, (method, group) in enumerate(restoration['table'].groupby('method', sort=False)):
    style = dict(marker='o' if i == 0 else 's', linestyle='None', markersize=7 if i == 0 else 10,
                 markerfacecolor='#1f77b4' if i == 0 else 'none', markeredgewidth=1.7)
    axes[0].plot(group.tie_capacity_kw, group.served_kw, label=method, **style)
    axes[1].plot(group.tie_capacity_kw, group.critical_kw, label=method, **style)
axes[0].set(ylabel='Total served (kW)', xlabel='Tie capacity (kW)')
axes[1].set(ylabel='Critical served (kW)', xlabel='Tie capacity (kW)')
axes[0].legend(fontsize=8); axes[1].set_ylim(0, 100)
fig.suptitle('Sampled capacity levels; coincident markers indicate equal outcomes', fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
assert restoration['table'].MILP_matches_exhaustive_check.all()

ATTACK_SCALES = (0., .25, .5, 1., 1.5)
started = time.perf_counter()
cyber = lab.cyber_sweep(ATTACK_SCALES)
timings['L8 fresh WLS attack sweep'] = time.perf_counter() - started
display(cyber['table'])
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 3.2))
for attack, group in cyber['table'].groupby('attack', sort=False):
    axes[0].plot(group.scale, group.J, 'o-', label=attack)
    axes[1].plot(group.scale, group.state_error_rad, 'o-', label=attack)
axes[0].axhline(cyber['table'].threshold.iloc[0], color='#b7502e', linestyle='--', label='99% threshold')
axes[0].set_yscale('symlog', linthresh=10)
axes[0].set_yticks([0, 5, 15, 50, 200, 600], labels=['0', '5', '15', '50', '200', '600'])
axes[0].annotate('Threshold = 15.09', xy=(1.5, 15.086), xytext=(.87, 22),
                 color='#b7502e', fontsize=8)
axes[0].set(xlabel='Attack scale', ylabel='WLS residual J (symlog scale)', ylim=(0, 700))
axes[1].set(xlabel='Attack scale', ylabel='Offline state error (rad)')
axes[0].legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left'); axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

without_trust = lab.trusted_response(cyber, protected_available=False)
with_trust = lab.trusted_response(cyber, protected_available=True)
display(pd.DataFrame([
    {'condition': 'No trusted replacement channels', 'status': without_trust['status'],
     'u_pu': None, 'offline_actual_violations': None},
    {'condition': 'Three trusted channels assumed', 'status': with_trust['status'],
     'u_pu': with_trust.get('flexible_injection_pu'),
     'offline_actual_violations': with_trust.get('actual_violation_count')}]))
print(with_trust['assumption'])
assert without_trust['status'] == 'HOLD'
assert with_trust['actual_violation_count'] == 0

archived_reasons = []
for case, backend in [('voltage', 'lindistflow3'), ('restoration', 'lindistflow3'), ('cyber_stealth', 'dc')]:
    run = lab.archived_stage_replies(case, backend)
    for event in run['trace']:
        response = event.get('response', {})
        reply = response.get('language_response') if isinstance(response, dict) else None
        if reply:
            archived_reasons.append({'case': case, 'stage': event['stage'],
                'choice': reply.get('choice', reply.get('ranking')),
                'exact_public_reason': reply['reason'], 'recorded_call_s': reply['seconds']})
display(pd.DataFrame(archived_reasons))
display(pd.DataFrame([{'fresh_operation': key, 'this_run_seconds': value} for key, value in timings.items()]))
print('Recorded model latency and this-run calculation times are different measurement boundaries.')

# Every actual trace event, including deterministic simulation and verification.
from IPython.display import HTML
for case, backend in [('voltage', 'lindistflow3'), ('restoration', 'lindistflow3'), ('cyber_stealth', 'dc')]:
    full_trace = lab.archived_stage_table(lab.archived_stage_replies(case, backend))
    assert full_trace.stage.nunique() == 5
    display(HTML('<details open><summary>ARCHIVED ACTUAL: ' + case +
        ' — all five stages, every recorded event</summary>' +
        full_trace.drop(columns='role_group').to_html(index=False, escape=True) + '</details>'))
print('Selected returned fields are exact archive values; complete records: results/proposal_complete_workflow.json')

if RUN_LOCAL_LLAMA:
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    from src.proposal_workflow import ProposalLlama
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ')
    journal = ROOT / 'results' / f'classroom_llama_{stamp}.json'
    client = ProposalLlama(journal, model='llama3.1:8b')
    live_reply = client.ask('Optimization Agent', pool['context']['public_context'],
                            list(pool['context']['catalog']))
    print('NEW LOCAL CALL; no dispatch:', live_reply)
    print('Exact journal:', journal)
else:
    print('SKIPPED: no new model call. L3 and L10 remain explicitly archived actual responses.')

checked = selected_trials['evaluations']['frozen LinUCB']
handoff_request = {'case': asdict(selected_trials['case']), 'revision': 1}
handoff_candidate = checked['candidate']
handoff_evidence = lab.bind_evidence(handoff_request, handoff_candidate, checked['summary'])
full_scope = lab.operator_packet(handoff_request, handoff_candidate, handoff_evidence,
    checked['feasible'], scope='MV phases only', required_scope='full MV/LV')
mv_scope = lab.operator_packet(handoff_request, handoff_candidate, handoff_evidence,
    checked['feasible'], scope='MV phases only', required_scope='MV phases only')
wrong_id = lab.acknowledge(mv_scope, 'wrong-id', 'Student operator')
readback = lab.acknowledge(mv_scope, mv_scope['recommendation_id'], 'Student operator')
display(pd.DataFrame([{'request': 'full MV/LV', **full_scope},
                     {'request': 'explicit MV teaching scope', **readback}]))
assert full_scope['state'] == 'HOLD' and not full_scope['acknowledged']
assert wrong_id['acknowledgment_result'] == 'REJECTED'
assert readback['acknowledged'] and not readback['equipment_dispatch']
